newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens, ABB win Ukranian power plant order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens, ABB win Ukranian power plant order.

text.p: Germany's Siemens AG said on Tuesday its KWU unit and ABB unit ABB Kraftwerke AG had won an order from Ukraine worth 130 million marks to upgrade a coal-fired generating plant.
Siemens said in a statement the companies would upgrade the Zmiev power plant 50 km southeast of Charkov to 325 megawatts capacity from the current 270 megawatts.

"This pilot project is the first tangible contribution toward creating replacement power generating capacity for Chernobyl in accordance with the Memorandum of Understanding signed jointly by Ukraine and the G7 states," it said.
It said the project was receiving political support from Germany in the form of a Hermes export insurance coverage.
German Chancellor Helmut Kohl is currently visiting Ukraine.
